title: Extract Frames from WebM
cap_description: Decode the WebM video track and emit each frame as a PNG image
documentation:
## Purpose

Decodes a WebM video and emits its frames as a sequence of PNG images. With no `--fps` argument every decoded frame is emitted; with `--fps N`, frames are decimated to approximately `N` per second by selecting the first decoded frame whose presentation timestamp passes each `1/N`-second boundary.

## Inputs

- A WebM file (path or stdin).
- An optional target frame rate (default: every frame).

## Outputs

A sequence of PNG images, one per emitted frame.

## Notes

- Decoding happens in-process via embedded ffmpeg static archives — no system ffmpeg dependency, no shell-out.
- For audio extraction from the same file, use [Extract Audio Track from WebM](https://capdag.com/browse/cap:extract-audio-track;in="media:webm;video";out="media:opus;audio").

args.arg_description: Path to the WebM file to process
Target frames per second. Omit to emit every decoded frame.

output.output_description: PNG images, one per emitted frame
